info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Insurance API allows users to access detailed information about insurance coverage for pharmacy prescriptions. This endpoint is designed for healthcare providers, pharmacies, and insurance companies to retrieve relevant insurance data associated with prescriptions. It enables stakeholders to efficiently verify coverage options and determine patient eligibility for medication prescriptions. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications' capabilities to manage prescription insurance details effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the insurance information associated with prescriptions. It provides details necessary for understanding coverage, copay, and other relevant insurance data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve insurance information related to prescriptions. It expects a JSON payload that aligns with the defined schema for insurance-related operations.
